method: local shallow clone source inspection; README-only claims excluded from decision evidence

behavior_excerpts: Rust workspace includes core, mcp-server, cli, web, lsp, and e2e crates with SurrealDB, tree-sitter, MCP, fastembed, and notify dependencies.
MCP entrypoint supports stdio, HTTP daemon, background start/stop/status, and auto-index flags; daemon stores DB/PID/log state under ~/.codescope and serves web plus MCP under /mcp.

GraphRagServer merges many tool routers, keeps active project context, readiness-gates tools during indexing, injects token-saving MCP instructions, and stores large outputs in a bounded in-memory archive.

Indexing pipeline stages parse results before clearing DB tables, walks files with ignore/gitignore handling, parses in rayon, writes graph entities/relations, resolves calls, syncs git/conversations, embeds, and starts watchers.
GraphQuery exposes function search, callers/callees, file entities, raw query, stats, and explore with limits/timeouts; GraphBuilder batches UPSERT and relation insertion into SurrealDB.

Installer downloads release assets, installs binaries to ~/.local/bin or existing install dir, installs bundled surreal under ~/.codescope/bin, may stop running codescope processes, and may alter shell PATH in interactive mode.
Package scripts dragon-brain and claude-memory launch claude_memory.server:main; dependencies include graphiti-core, FalkorDB, MCP, Qdrant, sentence-transformers, FastAPI, Redis, and Streamlit.

FastMCP server eagerly instantiates embedding, memory, clustering, and librarian services and registers tools for entity/relationship CRUD, observations, sessions, temporal queries, graph traversal, search, hologram, archive/prune, and stats.
MemoryService wires AsyncMemoryRepository, QdrantVectorStore, ontology, lock manager, query router, activation engine, FTS store, and reranker behind CRUD/search/temporal/analysis mixins.
FalkorDB repository handles node/edge/raw Cypher operations with retry; vector store lazily creates Qdrant collection, payload name index, cosine search, MMR, and ID retrieval scoring.

Search mixin supports neighbors, shortest path, cross-domain patterns, evolution, point-in-time vector queries, and knowledge-state diffs; ContextManager trims retrieved nodes under a heuristic token budget.
Inspected source shows persistent memory retrieval, not an automatic codebase parser/indexer; token-saving surface is recall of selected memory/session entities.
Python package memex-mcp exposes memex CLI; npm wrapper requires uv and delegates to uv tool run --from memex-mcp memex.

MCP server lists project/symbol/decision/problem/search/stale/write/explain/predict/context-briefing tools, validates config, checks Neo4j unless MEMEX_INTROSPECTION_ONLY=1, and supports stdio and HTTP transports.
Read tools assemble Markdown context from Neo4j/Graphiti queries and record approximate output-token telemetry; get_context_briefing uses priority sections and len/4 token budget truncation.

Tree-sitter extractor emits function/class symbols for multiple extensions and Python-only call-site edges; writer persists structured Symbol nodes and conservative CALLS edges before best-effort Graphiti episodes.
Watcher daemon writes PID files, installs git hooks, starts filesystem observers and commit pollers, launches initial lockfile indexing, and runs decay scheduling.
Schema defines write_policy defaults for locked/open/self node classes and associated write-policy errors.
npm scripts run ts-node ESM entrypoint for index, query, mcp, and build; dependencies are MCP SDK, sqlite/sqlite3, glob, ts-node, and TypeScript.
CLI index command opens .ckg-index.db in current working directory, clears nodes and edges, indexes target directory, and closes DB; query command does SELECT * FROM nodes WHERE name LIKE ?.
Indexer scans only **/*.{ts,js} excluding node_modules, dist, and .git; reads files fully; TypeScript AST extracts function, class, and method declarations with line ranges.
SQLite schema stores nodes with id/name/type/path/startLine/endLine/content and edges with from_id/to_id/type plus indexes on path/name.
MCP server exposes search_nodes and get_node_details over stdio; search is name LIKE with optional type filter; details return node row and children through contains edges.
No call/import/inheritance/dependency edges, incremental indexing, output compression, semantic search, or tests were present in inspected source.
